newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended May 14 rose to $959.43 billion from a revised $952.73 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 662 retail money market mutual funds rose $1.76 billion to $638.42 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds rose $1.72 billion to $525.98 billion, while assets of the 260 tax-exempt funds rose $42.8 million to $112.45 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 324 institutional money market funds rose $4.93 billion to $321 billion. Of these, assets of the 261 taxable money market funds increased $5.18 billion to $288.13 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $247.8 million to $32.87 billion, it said.
ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $952.73 billion from $952.54 billion.
